adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, the new fallback path fetches a credential by id only (`prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })`) when it is not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, and then uses it to instantiate a calendar client and delete events. The diff shows no subsequent validation that the fetched credential’s `userId`/`teamId` matches `bookingToDelete.user` (or any authorized team member), so a stale or foreign `credentialId` in a BookingReference could cause deletion using someone else’s OAuth credential. This authorization/scope check gap is directly visible in the added code.
